summary: The agent read the requirements and saved an updated document that still contains 11 requirements, with no open questions, after removing Q-006 and Q-007. Its reply highlights REQ-008 (unique 2 to 20 character display names, with the server keeping one user id per name) and REQ-005 (display currency limited to CHF, EUR or USD), and it notes that other currencies were added to out of scope. Both tool calls succeeded, so there are no failures to chase, but before approving you should confirm that the removed questions really are resolved and that the out-of-scope entry for other currencies matches what the stakeholders agreed.
